game: Quake E1M1 on Mac; software renderer, 320 × 240
model: google/gemma-4-31b-it, Modular Cloud, temperature zero, reasoning disabled
question: Does an aligned, visible-surface depth image help the agent recognize walkable paths?

paired_method.inputs: Both arms received the same 640 × 260 canvas with identical decoded RGB on the left. In the RGB arm the right panel was blank. In the depth arm it showed a co-registered, nearest-neighbor enlarged 80 × 60 depth sample from that instant. A fixed log scale made near surfaces light. Purple masked unavailable samples, HUD and the central weapon region. No entity list, world coordinates, level geometry, hidden surfaces or successful route entered the prompt.
paired_method.scene: Archived, unsuccessful agent exploration starting at the E1M1 entrance supplied reproducible evaluation positions. Hold the camera level and settle for 32 ticks at each new heading. Start the three trial branches at the identical native state hash. Sampling and scoring use evaluator coordinates offline. Only the images and a fixed instruction reach the model.
paired_method.trials: On separate branches, turn 32 degrees left, stay centered, or turn 32 degrees right, and hold forward 320 for 44 ticks at 72 Hz. Viable means at least 96 units of forward-projected progress without ending over 64 units lower. A choice succeeds when that direction is viable, or the model chooses scan and all three are blocked.
paired_method.order: Same prompt and encoding, alternating paired request order. Labels were established by the simulator separately from model calls. Intervals in scores are exploratory 95% bootstrap intervals over spatial anchors.
paired_method.first_set: Six distinct starting cells from each of two unsuccessful sessions, three perturbed directions per anchor. Primary adoption criterion specified before the test: at least ten percentage points higher choice accuracy and no drop in balanced three-sector accuracy.
paired_method.challenge_set: Separate start ticks. One mixed-passability view per new 42 × 42 × 32 start cell in seeded sampling order. Exactly one or two of three directions were viable. Native probes selected all 24 cases before any model judgments on this set.
paired_method.limits: Local walking test. Jumps, switches, long-horizon route selection, model training and transfer to a second level were outside this comparison. The challenge and first samples have different case mixes. The two short real-time runs per arm are descriptive and latency affects the game state.

live_method: Two fresh 40-game-second attempts per arm from the entrance, empty per-run map and skill database. Both used the production single-call agent, RGB HUD damage response and real-time clock. The image wrapper added the same blank or auxiliary panel as specified above. One coverage cell is a distinct 64-unit cube visited at a decision end, scored offline. No agent was given earlier paths.
